clause_notes.machine_checked_ask: askFirst is a word list copied into the worker prompt (worker/contract.ts). protocol/rules.ts checks that the list is words. The model decides whether to ask. There is no machine-checked refuse list.
clause_notes.daily_cap: Caps are rule parallel, worker.capacity (default 2), and maxActive. No per-day start counter. A cron line that says every day is a schedule, not a cap.
clause_notes.per_subject_worktrees: No git worktree add. A rule has one cwd. The only worktree strings are a Claude plugin comment and a recipe key named worktree-busy.
